facts.business: Automobile Corporation of Goa Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of all types of bus variants such as LCV, ICV, MCV, HCV, sleeper coaches, mobile vans, ambulances, and defense vehicles.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to incentive or external pressures to meet expectations, potentially resulting in revenue being overstated or recognized before control has been transferred
Related party transactions requiring assessment of arm's length pricing and compliance with statutory regulations (Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI Regulations)
facts.related_party_note: Revenue contains significant related party transactions. The auditor verified the Company's analysis in relation to arm's length assessment and obtained independent confirmations from related parties. Compliance with Section 177 and Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI (LODR) 2015 was assessed.
